comparison.objective: Release a fire door by lifting its hold-open hook and removing its stop so it closes; candidate tunes a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Hook release and obstruction removal versus hex-key seating, collar adjustment, bimanual counterholding, and locking.
comparison.success_condition: Door closes after both restraints are removed versus two dynamically acceptable stops with no setting drift. Record supplies no body or specs.
comparison.reason: Releasing an existing closure mechanism differs from iterative damping adjustment and retention verification.
